messages:
mike: FYI — rack g2-07 came back from rotation yesterday and we started the 48h soak. Seeing intermittent Xid 13/31 spikes and ECC corrected error bursts on GPU 2 and 5. attaching kernel snippets. can someone triage?

sasha: can you paste `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,PCI,UTILIZATION` from the nodes showing the errors? also which driver version? :eyes:

mike: driver 535.86, kernel 6.1. Logs:```[  344.120123] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00:00): 31, pid=2222, GPU has fallen off the bus``````[  344.120456] EDAC MC0: CE error detected on CPU memory at channel 1```
I ran a quick memtest on host, passed. NV logs attached to ticket INF-4521.

joel: Xid 31 often points to a GPU or PCIe link issue. Does this correlate with a PDU event? I saw the rack got PDU firmware updates during rotation. :thinking:

alexa: yep, ops swapped PDUs before we put the rack back in. firmware v1.2.4 -> v1.3.0. power logs show 2 brownouts during the first night (quick dips of ~200ms). could be coincidental but marking it.

infra-bot: automated-soak-check results for g2-07: GPU2:ECC_CORRECTED spikes 11->45 between 22:00-02:30, GPU5:Xid 13 x3 at 02:12, 03:05, 04:40. Thermal drift +3C during those windows. Relevant job: soak-run-1951.

sasha: let's try to reproduce with targeted stress: run this on the node for 2h and stream dmesg:```sudo apt-get install -y stress-ng gpu-burn cuda-memtest; stress-ng --gpu 2 --hdd 0 --matrix 0 --timeout 2h &
watch -n 5 nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv```

mike: started reproducer on g2-07-node3 at 13:10 UTC. will paste output if Xid/ECC shows. note: initial run produced Xid after ~45m when we mixed fp16 generation + large KV cache warmup.

joel: if PDU dips are in play, reseat the GPU and check riser seating/PCIe retimer logs. also confirm PEX lanes aren't degrading. run `lspci -vvv` and grep for AER/Advanced Error Reporting.

mike: reseat done at 14:05. lspci shows no AER errors pre-fail, but dmesg had `pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Corrected error received: ID 0000`. hard to attribute.

oncall: capacity note — draining g2-07-node3 will reduce us-west1 GPU spare pool below 8% during business hours. if we need replacement, we might have to shift jobs to us-east1 (cross-region egress/cost and latency impact). raising INC-7789 for capacity planning. :warning:

alexa: suggested immediate steps: 1) continue 2h targeted stress on both affected nodes, 2) schedule extended 24h thermal cycle (fan profile toggles + PTC), 3) keep nodes drained from production until soak passes.

mike: reproducer hit Xid 13 at 13:58, attached dmesg snippet:```[13:58:04] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00:00): 13, pid=4511, GPU has fallen off the bus
[13:58:05] gpu 0000:3b:00.0: enet link flaps detected, PCIe root port reset
[13:58:07] kernel: pciehp: PCI slot change detected on slot 1
```

sasha: with those symptoms, I want to separate thermal vs electrical. Can you run the stress with a forced lower clock and see if it still fails? e.g., `nvidia-smi -lgc 300,300` to lock clocks and rerun. if it still fails, likely hardware/PCIe.

mike: ran locked-clock stress for 3h — no Xids, ECC_SERIES stayed low. unlocked clocks reproduce within 50m. suggests instability under boost/thermal load.

joel: that's telling — instability under boost could be silicon degradation or power delivery. since ECC corrected increased earlier, it's borderline. hardware-team, recommend post-soak bench and targeted PDU power trace for g2-07 during a reproduce window. also get S.M.A.R.T and BMC logs for the hosts.

hardware-team: acknowledged. we'll schedule a replacement GPU for GPU5 if extended soak with controlled clocks passes/fails threshold of 60 corrected ECC in 24h. will coordinate courier for RMA if needed. please leave node drained.

mike: action items captured: 1) extended 24h soak with clock lock + thermal cycle (mike), 2) PDU power-trace during reproduce window (alexa/ops), 3) collect BMC/S.M.A.R.T + riser photos (joel), 4) update INF-4521 and INC-7789 for capacity.

alexa: small note on cost: if we cross-region shift jobs to east, estimate +$1.2k/mo in egress and scheduling impact — raising in the ticket.

infra-bot: next-check scheduled in 6h. soak-run-1951 logs archived to s3://infra-soak-logs/1951234567/.

mike: thanks all. i'll post a short follow-up after 24h soak. :thumbsup:
